reason: The right diagram is compact, legible and well routed with a legend, while the left diagram has a huge empty gap and tiny monospace labels, and the right adds a clear buffer-limit callout with a to-scale outage bar.

The right sequence diagram uses readable sans labels with colored alt/else regions and a legend, and its rules and targets are better emphasized, while the left diagram is tiny monospace with a phone layout that is cramped.
The right flowchart is compact with short clear branches and a legend, plus path summaries and worked fee examples, whereas the left flowchart has long meandering connectors and tiny labels.
The right architecture diagram is compact, nested and legible with a legend, while the left one is sprawling with long lines, tiny monospace labels and large empty areas.

The right sequence diagram has numbered steps, a highlighted one-time-code callout and a to-scale lifetime bar chart with a hierarchy-rich layout, while the left sequence diagram is tiny monospace text that overflows its column on desktop (though the right has a clipped chart footnote).

The right page has a clear options comparison, a horizontal bar chart showing the 17,600 gap and a cleanly formatted table, while the left has a broken table row (Lease payments 48 x $7 / 650) and a plainer layout.

The left page has a richer, more informative layout with a clear recommendation, a hatched out-of-contention bar, a labeled scatter plot and a cost breakdown, while the right is plainer and its bars are less distinct.

The left page has polished plan cards with a recommended highlight, a bar chart showing the Family Max delta and good dark-mode cards, while the right relies on a dense table and a big stat that adds less.

The right page gives option cards with status pills, a to-scale cost chart with the Kafka premium highlighted and an operations-effort chart, all readable at phone width, while the left has a plain table and a single bar chart.

The right page has well-formatted figures, flagged late bids, a net-benefit bar chart and a schedule-fit timeline against the school start date, whereas the left shows unformatted numbers like 7900000 and uses tables where a chart would help.
